Hi Emily / Rajiv,

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum.

Key pain points you called out:
- Data residency & regulatory constraints: certain PHI workflows must stay within the US and be auditable for HIPAA.
- Air-gapped requirement for a subset of workloads: you may need an on-prem or air-gapped deployment for offline processing.
- Strict egress controls: current network policy limits outbound connections and requires proxy/NAT configuration and documented endpoints.
- Audit & logging expectations: long-term audit log retention and integration with your SIEM.

Goals from your side:
- Proof-of-concept with private deployment in your VPC or on-prem (initial scope: inference-only, subset of models).
- Clear network checklist so your infra team can evaluate firewall/VPC peering needs.
- Procurement/contract timeline and required documentation (vendor questionnaire, SOC2/HIPAA evidence).

What we'll provide by EOD tomorrow:
1) Redwood private/VPC deployment checklist (attached) - network ports, egress endpoints, certs, and expected bandwidth.
2) Network matrix spreadsheet for Rajiv to map to your current firewall/NAT setup (attached).
3) A short note on air-gap options and estimated timeline for an air-gapped on-prem deploy.

Proposed next steps:
- Technical deep-dive with your network/security team: please suggest 60-90 minute slots next week. Marissa (Solutions Engineer) will join to run through network flows and keys.
- Procurement: Emily, if you can loop in the procurement contact(s) we'll send the standard vendor questionnaire and SOC2/HIPAA artifacts.

Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-checklist.pdf; acmehealth-network-requirements.xlsx

Thanks again - happy to jump on a quick follow-up if helpful.

Best,

Emily - great, thanks for the clarifications. Quick answers inline below and attaching the network matrix with notes.

> Air-gap: the requirement applies to batch processing of historical PHI (exported nightly).
We can support a hybrid model: on-prem (air-gapped) for the PHI batch jobs + Redwood-hosted for non-PHI real-time inference. Our on-prem package supports a scheduled sync/ingest process that can be configured to accept only encrypted, signed bundles and then purge after processing. I've added a short section in the checklist about retention and purge hooks.

> Egress: do you support static IPs or a CIDR list for egress endpoints?
We can provide a limited set of static egress IPs for Dedicated/Private. For fully air-gapped installs with zero egress, we provide an offline installer and a manual update process. See tab "Egress" in the attached spreadsheet.

> Auth & keys: HSM/KMS integration and rotation expectations.
We support customer-managed KMS keys (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and integration with common HSMs. Key rotation is supported on a 30/90-day cadence; Marissa will work with your infra team on the exact rotation playbook during the technical call.

Attachments: acmehealth-network-requirements.xlsx (updated)

Suggested slots for the technical deep-dive:
- Tue, May 25 - 10:30-12:00 PT
- Wed, May 26 - 10:00-11:30 PT

If those work, I’ll send a calendar invite and include Marissa from our Solutions Engineering team.

Best,
Camila
